image_description: The image displays two views of a silver-colored jeweler's loupe against a white background. The top view shows the loupe in an open position, revealing a convex glass lens housed in a circular metal frame attached to a hinged, teardrop-shaped protective casing. The bottom view shows the loupe closed, with the casing covering the lens. Both views feature engraved text on the metal surface.

The metal texture is overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the fine micro-scratches or machining marks expected on real metal tools. The reflections are slightly soft/diffuse rather than sharp.
